viewing_check: Estimate 60-90, current bid $25. Check for a Judge Ware (judge face) mark or any maker stamp on the bases, and for chips (rust at chips cuts value). Without a Judge mark the lot is generic enamelware worth far less than the Judge set prices. Prices are 2-3 years old and fairly stable. Bulky and heavy to post. Note: a further Judge Ware set of 4 sold A$134.54 on 28 Dec 2023, but its listing id was truncated so it is not recorded as an entry.
